decision_cruda.rationale: Este trucks haul 72 t/h, so about 504 t by 17:00. Este already has 176 t in the stockpile plus 457 t still in the stopes with working loaders, so supply (about 633 t) exceeds truck capacity. A loan to E543-01 would add almost no hauled ounces. Taking LH-08 or LH-09 would cost 1.0 to 1.5 oz per hour in development, plus travel time. LH-04 is repaired in place by 11:00 to 12:00 (likely 11:30), and the radio and CMMS agree on its status. Keep everything as is.
